findings.summary: The master-only-save design callout still describes only the three Linux legs (three entries of up to 1 GB per merge, ccache-linux-* entries, 'rather than 3 GB'); with the Windows legs a merge now saves six entries of up to about 6.6 GB in total
findings.scenario: A reader sizing the 10 GB cache quota from the callout underestimates per-merge cache growth by more than half and does not expect ccache-windows-* entries to be evicted or to evict others
